name: Fourier
summary: Fourier (formerly Fourier Intelligence) started in rehabilitation robotics and exoskeletons and moved into humanoids with GR-1 in 2023. Its humanoid line includes GR-2 and the care-focused GR-3.
funding: Backed by IDG Capital and Saudi Aramco, per Wikipedia.

sources.title: Fourier launches GR-2 humanoid, software platform
